bound_upstream.binding_is_enforced_in_code: app/research/mr002/phase3c/adopted.py re-hashes the adopted runner AND the mechanics block at import and raises AdoptionBindingViolation on any drift, so the R5A adoption cannot rot silently

coverage_against_the_owner_required_list.differential_vs_accepted_development_run: test_phase3c_agrees_with_the_accepted_development_runner - parameterized over five regimes: no trim, partial trim, larger partial trim, short-side trim, and full coupling liquidation

defects_found_and_fixed_during_qualifica.consequence_if_shipped: a false-positive INTEGRITY_FAILURE would have halted a perfectly valid replay, and the halt would have looked like a genuine governance finding
defects_found_and_fixed_during_qualifica.defect: the R6 post-execution drift check used an exact ratio test
defects_found_and_fixed_during_qualifica.fix: compare in the solver's own homogeneous weight units against its frozen primal feasibility tolerance PRIMAL_RESIDUAL_MAX (1e-9), not by exact ratio
defects_found_and_fixed_during_qualifica.symptom: it fired at |net|/gross == 0.050000 exactly, where the solver had legitimately brought the book to the band boundary

differential_result.compared: the accepted development runner's run_config against Phase 3C's run_config_validation, on identical synthetic non-sealed inputs
differential_result.significance: this is the evidence that the thin adapter did not move the already-exercised economics. It is worth more than a general test suite because it compares against the implementation that produced the accepted v1.1 development evidence.
differential_result.tolerance: none - equality, including the per-session determinism hashes

not_yet_done: no run against the sealed validation partition - the opening is NOT granted
the DSR trial-dispersion artifact is emitted only once a real replay produces the A/B/C annualized net Sharpes
a full-window dry run against a development-window FrozenDataset has not been executed here; the differential used synthetic fixtures spanning all five reduction regimes
purpose: owner step 6 - the executable identity and non-sealed qualification evidence that must exist BEFORE a new sealed validation opening is requested

qualification_run.command: docker run --rm --network=none -e PYTHONPATH=/work/apps/backend -v <repo>:/work -w /work/apps/backend mr002-research:v1.4 python -m pytest tests/research/phase3c --noconftest -v
qualification_run.conftest_note: --noconftest is required because the repo-wide backend conftest imports pytest_asyncio, which the research image does not carry. No Phase 3C test uses a conftest fixture.
qualification_run.log_retained: session scratchpad (not committed; the summary and hash are the record)

rulings_implemented.integrity_stop_is_not_an_economic_verdic: gates.evaluate short-circuits to INTEGRITY_FAILURE and never returns VALIDATION_DO_NOT_ADVANCE for a replay-definition failure
rulings_implemented.ruling_1_retired_3p5_sigma_trigger: phase3c/exits.exit_reason_validation takes NO confirm parameter and has no +/-3.5 rung; equivalence with the frozen ladder at confirm=False is proven across a parameter sweep
rulings_implemented.ruling_2_joint_construction_governing: phase3c/replay calls joint_portfolio.build_joint; the superseded v1.0 cascade is never invoked
rulings_implemented.ruling_3_configs_A_B_C: the runner is parameterized by CONFIGS[A|B|C]; no parameter search exists
rulings_implemented.ruling_4_replay_integrity_reserved: no replay_integrity metric, threshold or composite score was invented; integrity is expressed through already-frozen invariants and the typed IntegrityFailure
rulings_implemented.ruling_R5A_coupling_reduction_adoption: the adopted mechanics are reused verbatim and hash-bound at import
rulings_implemented.ruling_R6_drift_quantity_undefined: a surviving drift breach records the frozen ordering with quantity=None and raises INTEGRITY_FAILURE; coupling semantics are never borrowed for it

runtime.why_the_image_is_required: joint_portfolio._assert_registered_solver refuses to run unless /manifest/pip_report.json pins quadprog to the registered artifact cc1996a0...; that refusal is a control, so the qualification runs inside the frozen image rather than weakening it
